title: Claude Code — Budget (calendar month)
description: Monthly budget against spend. The time range is fixed to the whole calendar month in UTC (day 1 to the last day), so the chart shows the month at a glance; the stats cover the month so far. INCOMPLETE local coverage: see SOURCE_SUPPORT.md and RETENTION.md.

list.name: data_source
list.label: Data source
list.description: Local wiring: native supplies usage/cost; transcript supplies sanitized session/tool/context metadata without duplicate usage counters. All combines these disjoint signals. Synthetic values are test-only. Monthly coverage is incomplete with seven-day metrics retention.
list.query: transcript : transcript, real-otel : native|^$, all : .*, synthetic : synthetic, transcript-fixture : transcript-fixture

panels.title: Budget — INCOMPLETE: seven-day data, not full-month totals
Month to date (USD)
panels.description: Month to date: this panel ignores the time picker and always covers the current month so far (panel relative time now/M).
